changelog: Built and turned on a new sensor that watches the letsBONK launchpad on Solana. Every minute it asks the blockchain for the latest 150 letsBONK transactions and looks for the specific 'graduation' signature (when a token finishes its bonding curve and lists on Raydium). Each match gets logged to a new file (sol_letsbonk_graduation_log.json). This is purely a sensor - it does NOT buy anything yet. The bot needs about 20 logged graduations before it can decide whether trading them is profitable (about 4 days of data at the observed ~5 graduations per day).

Before turning on the sensor, the brain ran a 'smoke test' against a known-good graduation transaction provided by the research brain. The test passed - the sensor extracted the right token from the right transaction. This avoided the kind of silent failure that bit the bot in run-275 (where a sensor looked alive but was logging nothing useful).

The brain also caught a sizing bug before turning the sensor on: at 25 transactions per fetch and the actual letsBONK program throughput of 35 transactions per minute, the sensor would have been blind for ~18 seconds out of every 60-second cycle - missing roughly 30% of graduations by random luck. Raised the per-fetch count to 150, which gives the sensor a 4-minute lookback window with a 4-times safety margin.

No live-trading rules changed this run. The bot's entry/exit logic, position sizing, and risk gates are all identical to run-281. Only thing that changed is one new data sensor running in the background.

new_hypothesis.mechanism: Bags.fm tokens graduate from a Meteora Dynamic-Bonding-Curve to a DAMMv2 Raydium pool via the same Meteora DBC program (dbcij3L...) that hosts Believe and Jupiter Studio, but Bags-specific tokens are signed by creator authority BAGSB9TpGrZxQbEsrEznv5jXXdwyP6AXerN8aVRiAmcv. At graduation, Jupiter routing flips on, retail TG/X bots see 'graduated' status, and crucially Bags pays the creator 1% of every trade in perpetuity (vs pump.fun's 0.05%) — this gives KOL creators a structural incentive to schedule graduation-time shill posts, producing a reproducible 5–30 min reflexive bid window.
new_hypothesis.persistence: Bags graduations are estimated 3–7/day vs pump.fun's ~170/day — too thin to attract dedicated arb infrastructure; detection is non-obvious (shared Meteora DBC program means generic snipers conflate Bags with Believe/Jupiter Studio unless they filter on the BAGSB9...AmcV creator authority); the 1% perpetual creator royalty is a Bags-only structural feature retail bots have not internalized.
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: Trigger when migrate_meteora_damm or migration_damm_v2 instruction emitted by program dbcij3LWUppWqq96dh6gJWwBifmcGfLSB5D4DuSMaqN AND any account in the tx == BAGSB9TpGrZxQbEsrEznv5jXXdwyP6AXerN8aVRiAmcv. Filters: liq_usd >= $15k at graduation, age <= 5 min post-graduation, max market cap at entry <= $150k (graduation threshold ~$69-100k leaves headroom). Position size 1.5% (HALF of standard 3% pending sample), stop loss 8% (same as base), take-profit ladder same as letsbonk_graduation_snipe spec.
